items.titleEn: Meta Plans $300 Price Tag and Free 5G for Muse Charm AI Device
items.summaryEn: Meta plans to price its soon-to-be-released pocket-sized artificial intelligence (AI) device, Muse Charm , at $300 and offer buyers a free 5G data plan for up to 12 months, The Information reported Thursday (Nov. 19), citing an unnamed source. items.titleEn: Gold the top commodity pick for 2027 even as broader commodities likely to underperform – Morgan Stanley
items.summaryEn: (Kitco News) – While the U.S. dollar could strengthen modestly next year, oil prices will likely moderate toward $75 per barrel by the fourth quarter, and gold remains the top commodity pick for 2027, according to Morgan Stanley Research. “The biggest change since our midyear outlook is how much more attractive risk has become,” said Serena Tang, Morgan Stanley’s Chief Cross-Asset Strategist in the bank’s 2027 Global Investment Outlook published Wednesday. “Stocks and corporate bonds have cheapened even as expectations for AI investment have risen. And of course, we’re heading into 2027 with more clarity on two big unknowns—the U.S. midterm elections are behind us and markets better understand the Federal Reserve’s reaction function.” Morgan Stanley Research believes this combination will favor risk assets in 2027, with their strategists recommending a maximum overweight allocation to equities and neutral allocations to core fixed income and corporate credit, while they downgraded commodities and cash to underweight.

When something goes wrong with your car, getting the right part delivered quickly can make a real difference. By welcoming AutoParts.com onto our marketplace, we’re giving customers another way to get what they need, when they need it, and keep their day moving.”
